title: Speech Recognition Training Platform
description: End-to-end Whisper fine-tuning, built from an empty repository. Preprocessing with VAD (pyannote / Silero / Kaldi), Demucs source separation, segment-level deduplication and augmentation; distributed training on DeepSpeed ZeRO-2 across four GPUs; Prefect orchestration with MLflow tracking and GCS autoresume. Containerized for GCP/Vertex AI and AWS with regional Cloud Build and CI smoke tests. Built to operate over a corpus of 2,000 hours per language across 20 languages.

title: VOIT — Production Dubbing Platform
description: The company's live dubbing application. I wrote its first commit in April 2025 and built the original version end to end — transcription, translation, synthesis, Devanagari script handling, S3-backed staged storage, Lambda, and the migration to PostgreSQL. Dual-provider Voice Library with emotion and per-line variants; chunked synthesis to eliminate hallucination on long input; duration capping and speech-preserving timed placement so dubbed audio fits original timing. Cut editor page load 118x — 4,523 MB to 38 MB transferred, 13 GB to 176 MB of decoded resources.

title: AutoDub — Internal Speech Testing Platform
description: A separate internal tool — not the product, not customer-facing. Where new speech approaches get evaluated against our own use cases before anything reaches production, and where a few team members run interim dubbing work. Benchmarked commercial and open-source providers against our language mix and designed a dual-provider abstraction with fallback so no single vendor is a hard dependency. Prototyped automated dub QC grading accent, dialect and synthesis quality with an audio model instead of manual listening.

title: Cloud Migration & Storage Infrastructure
description: Multi-worker Google Drive to S3/Wasabi transfer and metadata-extraction services. Threaded parallel transfer, S3 access points, purpose-built IAM roles and bucket policies. Ran the production migration end to end — and concluded from the evaluation that Wasabi wasn't needed, removing a redundant storage tier.

title: Dub-Storage — Enterprise Media Platform
description: Role-based media file platform: folder hierarchies, cut-paste, restore, upload/download tracking, activity reporting, rate limiting. Fixed database connection-pool exhaustion under load and enabled large-file uploads.
